newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - FirstService Corp started.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - FirstService Corp started.

text.p: -- ABN AMRO Chicago Corp said Monday it initiated coverage of of FirstService Corp with a buy rating.

-- ABN AMRO said FirstService is poised to accelerate its acquisition strategy by taking advantage of fragmented industries and utilizing its recently clompleted credit agreement, which will be used to fund purchased.
-- The Toronto-based company provides property-related and business outsourcing services to consumer and business customers.
